purpose: Jurisdiction-specific authority references; not active-license verification or legal opinion

authorities.licensingBoard: Indiana Board of Licensure for Professional Geologists
authorities.boardNote: IGWS is the managing agency for the separate professional-geologist board; research institution itself does not license.

authorities.licensingBoard: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Geology)
authorities.boardNote: Under the Professional Geologist Licensing Act, the Illinois Department issues applicable licenses; official verification needed for individual work.

authorities.boardNote: License, registration, any statutory exemptions and scope must be confirmed with Kentucky's board for the specific work.
